appliance_decisions.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Remain asleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Resume sleeping.

appliance_decisions.activity: Waking up, showering and getting ready for work
appliance_decisions.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Put on clothes. Comb hair.

appliance_decisions.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
appliance_decisions.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Place bread in toaster. Push lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour water into mug. Add coffee. Stir. Sit. Eat. Drink coffee. Pick up plate. Rinse. Place in dishwasher.

appliance_decisions.activity: Commuting to the health facility for the day shift
appliance_decisions.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car at facility. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to facility entrance. Open door. Enter facility.

appliance_decisions.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
appliance_decisions.desc: Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to next patient. Take break. Walk to cafeteria. Buy coffee. Return to work. Attend meeting. End shift. Change out of scrubs. Walk to exit.

appliance_decisions.activity: Commuting home from the health facility
appliance_decisions.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car at home. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to house door. Unlock door. Enter house.

appliance_decisions.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after work
appliance_decisions.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Splash water on face. Dry face. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate.

appliance_decisions.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and tidying the kitchen
appliance_decisions.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Place utensils in basket. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wipe counter. Put away leftover food in containers. Open refrigerator. Place containers inside. Close refrigerator. Sweep floor. Empty trash. Replace trash bag. Turn off light.

appliance_decisions.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
appliance_decisions.desc: Enter living room. Walk to sofa. Sit down. Pick up remote. Press power button. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Change channel. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Eat snack. Turn off TV. Stand up.

appliance_decisions.activity: Using the computer to check emails and read health news
appliance_decisions.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to email. Delete spam. Close email. Open web browser. Type news website. Read health news. Click on article. Read article. Scroll down. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up.

appliance_decisions.activity: Taking a shower and brushing teeth
appliance_decisions.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth.

appliance_decisions.activity: Winding down with the desk lamp on, setting tomorrow's alarm
appliance_decisions.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 06:30. Place phone on nightstand. Pick up book. Read a few pages. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Wash hands. Return to bedroom. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Turn over. Sleep. Remain asleep.
